source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building fire-safety checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Include the date and time of the inspection.
3. Clearly identify the location and building name.
4. Document the name and qualifications of the inspector.
5. List the specific sections of the fire safety code or regulations that were not met.
    a. Specify the exact nature of the violation.
    b. Include any relevant photographs, videos, or drawings.
6. Record the details of processes or systems that failed.
    a. Describe the specific equipment or areas examined.
    b. Indicate the intended function and actual condition.
7. Summarize the conversation with building occupants or staff.
    a. Include names, positions, and contact details of the people spoken to.
    b. Note any concerns, questions, or explanations provided.
8. Provide the details of any immediate actions taken.
    a. Briefly describe any repairs, adjustments, or temporary measures implemented.
    b. Note if any authorities (e.g., fire department) were
